high_risk_moment: AI score computation before recruiter shortlist review
harm_description: Training data or scoring criteria encode historical demographic patterns that inflate or deflate scores for candidates with gender- or age-proxied resume features (e.g. graduation year, name, gap years), causing systematic shortlist exclusion.
existing_controls: None documented in the iTutorGroup case; no disparity monitoring or appeal path existed
proposed_controls: Remove or audit all features that serve as demographic proxies; conduct pre-launch disparate-impact testing across gender and age brackets; establish a secondary review queue for all below-threshold candidates
human_oversight: Every candidate below the shortlist threshold is still visible to a human recruiter in a secondary queue; a named appeal reviewer can reinstate any candidate within 5 business days of human rejection
monitoring_metric: Monthly shortlist recall gap by monitored demographic group
trigger_threshold: Recall gap above 5 percentage points for any group across two consecutive monthly evaluations
response_action: Suspend AI scoring immediately; preserve all scoring logs; conduct root-cause analysis; notify compliance; manually re-review all affected applications before resuming

high_risk_moment: Resume parsing and feature extraction for scoring
harm_description: LLM or scoring model assigns lower weight to experiences and credentials correlated with women's educational institutions or extracurricular language, causing qualified women candidates to rank lower than equally or less qualified men candidates.
existing_controls: Prototype was abandoned before deployment; no mitigations were tested in production
proposed_controls: Audit all features used in scoring for demographic proxy correlation; replace or down-weight proxy features; use a representative balanced evaluation dataset; require independent subgroup recall validation before launch
human_oversight: Recruiter must review a random 10% sample of all below-threshold candidates and all candidates within 10 percentile points of the shortlist cutoff
monitoring_metric: Subgroup shortlist recall rate and recruiter override rate by group
trigger_threshold: Recall gap above 5 percentage points or override rate above 25% for two consecutive evaluation runs
response_action: Block promotion to wider pilot; investigate proxy features; retrain or reconfigure scoring; require independent re-validation sign-off

high_risk_moment: AI-assisted interview analysis and score delivery to hiring manager
harm_description: Automated video interview scoring using facial expression or speech pattern features may systematically disadvantage candidates with motor, facial, or speech disabilities and non-native language speakers, creating discriminatory opportunity loss without the candidate's knowledge.
existing_controls: HireVue removed facial-expression component in 2021 under pressure; no mandatory pre-deployment audit existed
proposed_controls: Prohibit use of facial expression or speech-cadence features; restrict AI scoring to clearly job-relevant content; conduct accessibility review before any interview-analysis feature launch
human_oversight: Hiring manager receives AI-generated notes as optional context only; the hiring manager makes the independent shortlist decision and must document rationale; candidate can request human-only review
monitoring_metric: Accessibility complaint rate and self-disclosed disability candidate shortlist rate
trigger_threshold: Any accessibility complaint related to interview AI or disability-group shortlist rate dropping below general-population rate
response_action: Disable interview AI scoring; notify affected candidates; conduct independent accessibility audit before re-enabling
